notes.title: About the future of Milliopoly
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]Milliopoly hasn’t received the attention it deserves for quite some time, and its current state isn’t quite what I had planned for the final version.[/p][p]As a solo-dev project, Milliopoly is currently very simple: the UI (which the whole game is based on) is basic, transitions and visuals are minimal, and there aren’t many gameplay options. Some questions also need polishing. Altogether, the game could really benefit from some updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Screenshots of the current version:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42709821/4a9790819786484883b0525e2e5aa1da6022b651.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42709821/2dfa10bbfc1d29d8d34c2af3362d899780ba24cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unfortunately, the original project files with the latest update were lost, which is why there haven’t been updates for so long. I had to rebuild the game from scratch, but I’m much happier with the results. I’d like to share a preview, though it’s still a work in progress and will receive more tweaks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Preview of the upcoming update (planned for 2026):[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42709821/a0024ce2c1a3d7b21322fc864ea091aab2332e5c.png"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="182QkPqCXZw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This update is primarily a visual overhaul, but there’s much more going on behind the scenes. You can expect new modes, improved questions, and a game experience much closer to what I originally envisioned. My hope is that you, the players, will enjoy this direction.[/p][p]Since I’m working on this alone, I’ll leave the release window as simply [b]2026[/b] (no exact date yet). Until then, the current version of the game remains fully playable.[/p][p]Finally, while original plans like adding more languages (such as Italian) aren’t completely off the table, they’re not my priority anymore. For now, my focus is on quality over quantity. I want Milliopoly to be the best experience it can be.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the news![/p]

notes.title: v0.11
notes.notes:
- Visual improvements: Now the UI in the game works better for all resolutions.
- Bugs fixes

notes.title: Patch 0.9
notes.notes:
- Now the Career Mode challenges have their own description in each language.
- Successfully completing a challenge (all correct answers) provides you 10k EXP points.

Soon: EXP points achievements, listening comprehension mode, more challenges, and more options and categories in Spelling Mode and Sound Check Mode.

Any feedback is welcome. Don't forget to leave a Steam review telling what you think of the game, or report a problem on the Steam Discussions Board.
Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 0.7 - Spelling Mode & Level System
notes.notes:
Updated:
- New level system added. Earn experience by answering questions, and level up within the game (Soon more features and achievements related to your level)
- New mode available on the Feature Shop: Spelling mode. Practice spelling words you hear in all languages. In-game virtual keyboard available for gamepad play.
- New questions were added for all languages, modes, and categories
- Playing Ranked Mode is a little cheaper now.
- Tons of improvements and fixes (What can I say? I'm a perfectionist. But there's still a long way to go)

Soon:
- More stats available on the Profile Window
- More Sound Check categories
- Visual enhancements
- New mode(s) in which you type stuff
- And, of course, more questions for all languages, modes, and categories

notes.title: Patch 0.6 - Shop, Sound Check Mode, Culture and Geography categories, and more
notes.notes:
31/08/2022
- Game Shop added: Now you can purchase new features to practice even more
- Sound Check Mode added. Practice minimal pairs in multiple languages to improve your pronunciation and listening comprehension. Purchase it on the in-game store (no real money needed)
- Culture category added for Custom Mode. Purchase it on the in-game store (no real money needed)
- Geography category added for Custom Mode. Purchase it on the in-game store (no real money needed)
- More than 100 questions were added to ranked and custom modes, for all languages
- Visual improvements
- Bugs fixes

Zoe's notes:
"Here are some upcoming features.
- Listening comprehension mode, including a mode similar to the ones within the most renowned proficiency exams
- Spelling mode
- Option to choose specific topics in Custom Mode (examples: Simple Past Tense, Clothing vocabulary, Texts about vacations, etc.)
- Detailed and translated description for each challenge of each language in Career Mode
- More clarity on what the goals of the game are, especially focusing on assessment rather than on passive learning.

I really hope the people playing the game for whatever purposes are enjoying it and that it has helped you practice, learn, test your knowledge or just have fun! :)"
